scientific_integrity: The all-order formulas are proved from circulation-space polarity, the forest criterion, and irreducible permutation symmetry. Computations provide finite checks and do not stand in for an infinite proof. No independence or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The formulas concern only the orthogonal projection of edge-coordinate basis vectors onto the complete-graph real circulation space; no metric invariance under arbitrary regular-matroid representations is asserted. Finite enumerations test only orders 4, 5, and 6. Independent audit and certification have not been performed.
title: Parity-sharp John and Löwner balls of orthogonal cographic complete-graph polytopes
